jobs.title: Recruiting Operations Specialist (Contract)
jobs.description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. We’re looking for a highly organized and proactive Recruiting Operations Specialist to support our Talent team in delivering an exceptional candidate experience. In this role, you’ll work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates to schedule interviews and keep our hiring processes running smoothly and efficiently. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast-paced, high-growth startup and play a key role in our mission to attract world-class talent. What you’ll do Own interview scheduling across multiple time zones, keeping candidates, hiring managers, and interviewers aligned. Be a first point of contact for candidates, providing timely updates and a professional experience. Maintain accurate data in Ashby and prepare recurring reports for the Talent team. Identify bottlenecks in our workflows and help implement improvements, including automation. Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to align on scheduling priorities. What we’re looking for 1+ years of experience as a recruiting coordinator, executive assistant or in a similar scheduling-heavy role Hands-on experience with an ATS (Ashby preferred) and Google Calendar Strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing deadlines Fluent written and spoken English A service-minded approach to candidates and internal stakeholders Availability to overlap with US working hours About the Team: Our talent team is fully remote, embracing async communication and collaboration through Slack channels, thorough documentation, and proactive updates to keep work moving forward smoothly across time zones.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, People Operations
jobs.description: Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one. Customers and users across the globe use Planet s data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles. As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains. We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world. Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands. About the Role:   Planet’s People Operations team manages a wide variety of operational functions, including compliance, HRIS and hire-to-retire transactions, immigration, global mobility, people data and analytics, and payroll. We are seeking an experienced Senior People Operations Manager to oversee people operations across Europe, MENA, and APAC while ensuring alignment with global frameworks and strategic objectives.
